text:
Anna (People Ops): FYI — Lina starts next Monday. I sketched a compact week0 checklist for managers + HR to confirm. Can you scan and flag gaps?

Jordan (Eng Manager): Thanks Anna — sending quick glance now. TL;DR: want goal for week: ship a small "first-issue" PR and meet immediate teammates.

Mike (HR): Uploading our 30/60/90 template here for alignment. I prefer a 3-line goal per window + success metric. Also confirm benefits intro on day 3.

Sasha (IT): I'll queue device + access. Need Lina's preferred laptop OS and shipping address. Also, do we want MFA enforcement day0 or day1?

Anna (People Ops): MFA day0 if possible. Lina, can you confirm laptop preference?

Lina (New Hire): Hi all — MacBook Air M2 is great, same address on my offer doc. MFA fine day0. Thanks! :smile:

OnboardBot: Welcome Lina! :partyparrot: Checklist created: device order, Slack + GitHub invite, HR benefits packet, workspace setup task. See /onboard/1725502468.

Jordan (Eng Manager): Quick notes on manager checklist I added:
- Day0: intro sync + 30-min environment setup with Sasha.
- Day1: team standup intro, assign tiny onboarding ticket.
- Day2: pair with buddy on infra runbook.
- Day3: benefits + payroll 1:1 with Mike.
- End of week: 30-minute sync to set 30/60/90 goals.

Mike (HR): My additions:
- Paperwork review (tax forms, direct deposit) — schedule 30 mins day0 or day1.
- Benefits overview session (20 mins) day3.
- Compliance/security training link — complete by EOW.

Sasha (IT): Access list I'm provisioning:
```
- Slack (people-ops, eng, devex)
- GitHub org (repo read + triage for onboarding ticket)
- Jira (project dev-infra)
- Okta account + MFA
- VPN & internal docs (confluence)
```
I'll post invites once device order is in.

Jordan (Eng Manager): On the 30/60/90 templates — thinking of outcomes not tasks. Example:
```
30-day: ramp to dev env + close onboarding PR (metric: merged PR)
60-day: own a small feature + pass code review checklist (metric: 1 shipped story)
90-day: iterate on a component & present learnings (metric: design review delivered)
```
Seems reasonable?

Mike (HR): Looks good. We'll use that framing in the kickoff 1:1. Also propose manager sets weekly 1:1 cadence starting week0.

Anna (People Ops): A couple logistical checkboxes:
- Calendar invites for core onboarding (env setup, benefits, security) — Jordan, can you send?
- Buddy assigned: Priya from infra (cc'd in separate message).
- Office badge request if Lina will be in-office — Sasha, will you handle?

Sasha (IT): Badge request submitted. ETA 5 business days unless expedited. If Lina needs early access we can approve a pass for week0 — Jordan, let me know.

Lina (New Hire): I plan to be remote first week but may come in week2. Pass not needed yet. Thanks for the quick answers!

Jordan (Eng Manager): I'll send the calendar bundle: day0 env + 1:1 cadence + EOW sync. Also posting a short onboarding issue now: "welcome-lina-setup" with a checklist.

Anna (People Ops): Final HR ask: can manager confirm a brief success criterion for EOW sync (e.g., joined Slack, merged onboarding PR, completed security training)? If yes we'll mark onboarding complete in HR tracker.

Jordan (Eng Manager): Confirmed. EOW success = Slack joined, env working, onboarding PR merged, and compliance training started.

Mike (HR): Perfect — I'll update the HR tracker and send Lina a benefits packet email day1.

OnboardBot: Automated reminder scheduled: device order follow-up in 48h; security training reminder in 5 days.

Anna (People Ops): Thanks team — I'll close the loop after you post the invites. :thumbsup:

Jordan (Eng Manager): Done — invites sent and PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboard/issues/12

Sasha (IT): GitHub invite + Okta invite sent. Device order placed.

Lina (New Hire): Received invites, everything looks good. See you all Monday! :wave:
